name: hijapan
description: 纯本地、无后端的日语学习桌面软件

scripts.lint: oxlint src scripts tests forge.config.mts vite.main.config.mts vite.preload.config.mts vite.renderer.config.mts vitest.config.mts && oxfmt --check src scripts tests forge.config.mts index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.main.config.mts vite.preload.config.mts vite.renderer.config.mts vitest.config.mts README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix src scripts tests forge.config.mts vite.main.config.mts vite.preload.config.mts vite.renderer.config.mts vitest.config.mts && oxfmt --write src scripts tests forge.config.mts index.html package.json tsconfig.json vite.main.config.mts vite.preload.config.mts vite.renderer.config.mts vitest.config.mts README.md AGENTS.md
scripts.release:check: node scripts/content/validate-content.mjs --release && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
